title: Vanessa delivers pizza after work to pay rent. Many Australians are ‘scrambling’ as cracks appear in the economy
paragraphs: Vanessa Freitas is not feeling optimistic about her one-year-old daughter’s future in Australia.
Now an Australian citizen with a white-collar job in Sydney’s CBD, the 37-year-old worked as a nanny and house cleaner after moving from Brazil 13 years ago.

Freitas has moved at least 14 times since arriving in Australia and still can’t afford to buy a home, even though she and her partner are both professionals. They’re at their absolute limit for what they can afford to pay in rent.
